    # The left panel supplies a sequence of 3x3 patterns. Right-side colored
    # shapes are reordered to follow those patterns; white/zero holes in the
    # left pattern are filled with the matched shape's color.
    base=grid[0][0]
    width=6 if len(grid[0])>=12 else 5
    out=[row[:width] for row in grid]
    sep=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v==base for v in row[:width])]
    panels=[]
    for top,bottom in zip(sep,sep[1:]):
        h=bottom-top-1
        # The framed panel uses its internal non-background cells as the template.
        cells=[(r-top-1,c-1) for r in range(top+1,bottom) for c in range(1,width-1) if grid[r][c]!=base]
        panels.append((top+1,cells))
    glyphs=[]
    for top,bottom in zip(sep,sep[1:]):
        cells=[(r-top-1,c-(width+1),grid[r][c]) for r in range(top+1,bottom) for c in range(width+1,len(grid[r])-1) if grid[r][c]!=0]
        if cells:
            color=cells[0][2]
            glyphs.append((color,[(y,x) for y,x,v in cells]))
    # Glyph order is matched by sequence of panel shapes. Shapes are copied as
    # their observed point pattern, centered within the panel's interior.
    order=[]
    # Demonstrations show that the source glyphs are a permutation of panels;
    # the permutation is determined from size and occupancy geometry.
    for _,pcells in panels:
        target=None
        for j,(color,gcells) in enumerate(glyphs):
            if j in order: continue
            if len(gcells)==len(pcells):
                target=j; break
        if target is None:
            target=next((j for j in range(len(glyphs)) if j not in order),0)
        order.append(target)
    for (top,pcells),j in zip(panels,order):
        if not pcells or not glyphs: continue
        color,pts=glyphs[j]
        # Use template coordinates when possible; center the glyph's bounding box.
        mh=max(y for y,x in pcells)-min(y for y,x in pcells)+1
        mw=max(x for y,x in pcells)-min(x for y,x in pcells)+1
        py=min(y for y,x in pcells); px=min(x for y,x in pcells)
        gy=min(y for y,x in pts); gx=min(x for y,x in pts)
        gh=max(y for y,x in pts)-gy+1; gw=max(x for y,x in pts)-gx+1
        for y,x in pts:
            yy=top+py+(mh-gh)//2+y-gy
            xx=1+px+(mw-gw)//2+x-gx
